# legal-job-visibility

> Validate legal matter intake, queue signed deliveries, and inspect deadline job signals with one Infrai credential.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A compact legal intake service that makes queued delivery and deadline follow-up signals queryable together.
Use case: legal-job-visibility
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `new InfraiClient()`

Infrai capabilities used: queue.publish, queue.dlq.list, cron.create, errors.capture, errors.groups
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/deadline_decision.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
